statement: Pinned SDL constructs a nine-byte Bluetooth HID rumble report with report ID0x03 and separate left-trigger,right-trigger,low-frequency and high-frequency amplitude fields.

applicability.revision: standard Series identity where named; Elite and other revisions excluded
applicability.scope: Consumer evidence only: SDL_hidapi_xboxone.c:564-574; Bluetooth HID output, separate from GIP. No physical actuation/canonical firmware packet claim.
